author: ون بيس
theme: the world of the One Piece anime: the Straw Hat pirates sail the Grand Line on the Thousand Sunny; the ship's doctor Chopper is the recurring healer; stories end with a real line from One Piece, or a famous Arabic proverb or line of poetry spoken by one of the crew, in Arabic
numbering: Only the heart questions are made into lessons (the owner, 2026-11-24): Adult Cardiac Surgery = lessons 1-125, Congenital Heart Disease = lessons 251-328, in the order of the jsonl. The thoracic section (126-250) is left out.
style: a vivid anime illustration in the style of the One Piece anime (Eiichiro Oda's manga style): bold clean ink outlines, bright saturated cel-shaded colour, expressive exaggerated characters, dynamic adventurous composition, every object crisp and instantly recognisable
